name: 3x3 EYES ~Tenrin'ou Genmu~
source:
It tells the story of Yakumo, a normal Japanese teenager who studies and works as a waiter, and Pai, a girl who belongs to the race of sanzhiyan, the immortal three-eyed people. After having discovered the secret of eternal youth and immortality many hundred years ago, the sanzhiyan could not remain human, and became cruel demons capable of possessing people and turning them into "wu" (Chinese for "nothing") - immortal, powerful, and obedient servants. Pai, who looks like a young girl, but is nevertheless three hundred years old, was terrified by what the sanzhiyan have become, and swore she will find a way to become human again. She meets Yakumo, whose late father was a scientist who helped Pai on her quest. Accidentally, Pai uses the powers of her third eye on Yakumo, and he becomes her Wu! Trying to regain their lost humanity, Yakumo and Pai are confronted by the evil Benares, the Wu of the sanzhiyan ruler Kaiyanwang. In pursuit of Benares and his henchmen, Yakumo and Pai travel to India, the Easter Island, and many other countries. Will they be able to stop Benares and become human again?

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/3x3-eyes-tenrin-genmu]Mobygames[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了八云与佩的经历。八云是一名普通的日本少年，一边上学，一边做服务员打工。佩则出身于不死的三只眼一族。数百年前，三只眼一族发现了长生不老的秘密，却也无法再保持人类之身，化为了残酷的妖魔。他们能附身于他人，将其变成“无”——这个汉字意为“虚无”，指不死、强大且绝对服从的仆从。佩虽然外表仍是少女，实际上已经活了300年。族人的变化令她恐惧，她发誓要找到重新变成人类的方法。她遇见了八云。八云已故的父亲是一名科学家，曾帮助佩寻找变成人类的方法。一次意外中，佩对八云使用了第三只眼的力量，使他成为了自己的“无”！为了重新变回人类，八云与佩不得不面对邪恶的贝纳雷斯。他是三只眼一族统治者鬼眼王的“无”。为追踪贝纳雷斯及其爪牙，八云与佩前往印度、复活节岛等许多地方。他们能够阻止贝纳雷斯，重新变成人类吗？
